content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([0, 0, 5, 0], dtype=pd.SparseDtype("int", fill_value=0))
print(s.sparse.npoints)
content_blocks.expected_output: 1 (one value differs from the sparse fill value)
